status: FROZEN before any strategy in this catalog was run on the extra31 coins by this screen
nature: cross-symbol transfer SCREEN of unchanged rules; research only; no engine, runtime, account or key change; a pass is a lead for a full gated test, never an activation or promotion
approval: moe 2026-11-13 (project chat: 'go' + 'compile the biggest strategy list ever'); scope relayed by the coordinator

master.note: the 57 strategies registered in master strategies.py

c254.note: codex/bullish-long-line-c254, the top of the stacked C-candidate branches; only the 209 keys that are not on master run from here

source_files: each source is exported with git archive at its commit (top-level *.py, research/*.py, data/exchange_rules_testnet.json); strategy, backtest and module sha256 are recorded per result
rule_changes: none: signal functions, params and mgmt are the registered defaults; any change is a new candidate

universe.note: BTC is in the book for market context and cross-sectional ranks, never traded. A strategy's own 'exclude' list is honoured.

data.manifest_location: in the data folder or one level above it (D01 layout); each CSV sha256 is recorded with the count found in the manifest
data.bars: 1h native; 4h and 1d are UTC bins built from 1h, a bin needs all of its 1h bars else it is dropped; 15m does not exist in this data
data.late_listings: no candle is invented: coins are grouped by listing date and each group is run in its own book that starts at that date and holds BTC plus every coin already listed (the cross-sectional context of that moment); a coin's own first max(warmup, 720h / bar hours) bars are never traded (warmup 220 bars, 60 for 1d)

timeframe: the strategy's registered tf; strategies without a tf (the legacy set) run on 4h, the timeframe they were built on

execution.engine: the source commit's own unchanged backtest.run, pessimistic='path'
execution.sizing: start $10,000,000, risk 0.0000008 of equity = $8 per entry, max_pos 99 (every signal is taken, no ordering effect), max_lev 10, daily_halt 0.08 (cannot bind at this size)
execution.costs: base 5 bp fee + 2 bp slippage per side (7 bp); stresses add 8 / 16 bp on each trade's executed notional from the fill log (15 / 23 bp per side)
execution.funding: 0.01% per 8h charged per bar on open notional (engine proxy, not native funding)
execution.exchange_filters: data/exchange_rules_testnet.json of the source commit (current snapshot); symbols missing from it use the engine's legacy floor and are listed
execution.R: the engine's own R: trade P&L after costs divided by the $8 risk budget of the entry (|pnl / R| from the engine; the entry fill's risk when R is 0). Quantity is floored to the exchange step, so the risk actually taken can be below $8

pass_rule.halves: mean R at 15 bp > 0 in both halves (each half must have at least one trade)
pass_rule.ex_best_coin: mean R at 15 bp > 0 after removing the coin with the largest summed R at 15 bp
pass_rule.never: no gate is weakened, no parameter is tuned and no coin is dropped to rescue a strategy

skipped_already_tested_on_extra31.not_in_catalog: H5, RSR, SVS, IMP, PFX live in their own research modules and already failed on these coins

status_notes: NO_DATA_15M: 15m rule, the data is 1h. NO_DATA_INPUT: the rule reads an input (mark price, taker flow, minute bars, trade sizes) that this 1h price/volume data does not hold; it is listed, not judged. ERROR: listed with the error, not judged.
order: ema_st and kalman_innovation_recovery_long_1h (C101) are run and reported first; the order does not change any result
amendments: 2026-11-13, before any extra31 run: the first launch stopped at the manifest check because the manifest sits one level above clean/. The runner now also looks there and records each CSV sha256 with the count found in the manifest. No rule, universe, cost or gate changed.
limitations: about 290 strategies are screened at once, so a few passes by luck are expected; a pass only earns a full gated test (portfolio limits, order permutations, worst path, Codex reproduction)
not a fresh time period: the same calendar window as earlier development, different coins
every signal is taken independently (no position limit), so account-level interaction is not measured
hourly or coarser candles, engine path model, funding proxy, current exchange filters, fixed survivor universe
cross-sectional strategies rank inside this 31-coin + BTC universe, which differs from the one they were built on
